mentions.name: IKEA Symfonisk dial custom firmware
mentions.description: Custom firmware for IKEA Symfonisk dials that fixes bugs in the OEM firmware and adds features like hold and turn, with work on getting smooth dial behaviour over Zigbee.
mentions.problem: The OEM firmware on IKEA Symfonisk dials has some pretty bad bugs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Custom firmware for some ikea symfonisk dials because the oem firmware on them has some pretty bad bugs. Added features like hold and turn. Getting nice smooth dial behaviour over zigbee etc is surprisingly tricky
mentions.author: jhogendorn
